name: Wardrobe 1100 (zhitov drawing)
comment: From the zhitov.com drawing, resized to 1100 x 600 x 2450 overall (end panel and doors included; carcass 1082 wide, boards 559 deep + 3 HDF + 20 pocket to the wall), 18 mm board in U156 ST9. Generated by scripts/gen-wardrobe-zhitov.mjs — change the parameters there and re-run rather than editing coordinates by hand. Two carcasses like the hall wardrobe: a lower drawer carcass (bottom on six 100 mm legs, 314 sides and partition, full-width top at 432..450, HDF back) and an upper carcass standing on it (bottom at 450..468, 1964 sides, partition to the top shelf at 2014, top at 2432..2450, HDF back), joined by four screws down through the upper bottom. Columns 514 + 18 + 514. Right column: 4 adjustable 532-deep shelves on 5 mm pins with two spare holes above and below each (32 mm pitch, none where a shelf would hit a hinge plate); left column: hanging rail. Two drawers in the lower carcass: fronts 344 in the door plane (103..447), boxes 488 x 555 x 253 in the decor on 3 mm HDF bottoms stapled under the sides, on 550 roller runners. Doors 535 and 535 from 451 to 2447 (3 reveal at the wall, 4 between, 5 to the end panel). No top filler (ceiling 2515 stays 65 above the top); full-height end panel 2450 x 600 on the exposed right side; plinth clipped to the front legs. Two concealed wall hangers (Samet type) 60 above the top shelf, in the back corners of the top compartment, hook onto plates screwed to the wall in the 20 mm pocket behind the HDF, so the wardrobe cannot tip forward; it stands on its legs. Fasteners are modelled as hardware parts (not cut): confirmat 7x50 at every fixed carcass joint (caps 2 mm proud where visible, flush where covered), 4x30 wood screws for the stacking, end panel and drawer fronts, staples for the HDF. Hinges (cup, arm, plate) and handles are drawn by the viewer.

assembly.title: Lower carcass: bottom
assembly.note: Start with the bottom panel of the drawer carcass, front edge forward.

assembly.title: Lower carcass: left side
assembly.note: Stand the left side (314 tall) on the bottom, flush at the front, three confirmats from below through the bottom.

assembly.title: Lower carcass: right side
assembly.note: Same for the right side: three confirmats from below.

assembly.title: Lower carcass: partition
assembly.note: The short partition 514 from the left side, three confirmats from below.

assembly.title: Lower carcass: top
assembly.note: Lay the full-width top over the sides and the partition and fix it from above: three confirmats into each side and three into the partition, heads flush, the upper carcass will sit on them.

assembly.title: Lower carcass: back
assembly.note: Square it and staple the lower HDF back over the rear faces of bottom, sides, partition and top.

assembly.title: Legs
assembly.note: Turn the lower carcass over and screw the six adjustable legs to the underside of its bottom: three along the front edge, three along the back, the middle pair under the partition line. Wind them fully down to 100 mm (they adjust 100-150, so levelling later only goes up), then stand it back on its feet.

assembly.title: Upper carcass: bottom
assembly.note: On the bench, start the upper carcass with its bottom panel.

assembly.title: Upper carcass: left side
assembly.note: Stand the left side (1964 tall) on it, three confirmats from below through the bottom, heads flush.

assembly.title: Upper carcass: right side
assembly.note: Same for the right side.

assembly.title: Upper carcass: partition
assembly.note: The partition 514 from the left side, up to where the top shelf will sit, three confirmats from below.

assembly.title: Upper carcass: top shelf
assembly.note: The full-width shelf 400 under the top: three confirmats through each side and three down into the partition.

assembly.title: Upper carcass: top
assembly.note: Lay the top over the sides and fix it from above with three confirmats into each side, heads flush.

assembly.title: Upper carcass: back
assembly.note: Square it and staple the upper HDF back over the rear faces of bottom, sides, partition, top shelf and top.

assembly.title: Stack the upper carcass
assembly.note: Lift the upper carcass onto the lower one, flush at the front and both sides, and screw it down from inside: four screws through its bottom into the lower top.

assembly.title: Rail holders
assembly.note: Screw the two rail holders to the left side and the partition, 74 under the top shelf.

assembly.title: Hanging rail
assembly.note: Drop the rail into the holders from the front.

assembly.title: Shelf pins
assembly.note: Push four pins into the chosen holes for each adjustable shelf.

assembly.title: Adjustable shelves
assembly.note: Lay the 4 adjustable shelves on their pins.

assembly.title: Left drawer: box sides and ends
assembly.note: On the bench: the two sides stand outside the front and back pieces, two confirmats per corner through the sides, heads flush on the outside so the runners clear them.

assembly.title: Left drawer: bottom
assembly.note: Square the box and staple the 3 mm HDF bottom under it: four staples into each side, three into the front and three into the back.

assembly.title: Left drawer: runner, drawer part
assembly.note: Screw the drawer profile of each runner along the bottom edge of the box sides, wheel at the back, flush with the box front.

assembly.title: Left drawer: runner, cabinet part
assembly.note: In the lower carcass: screw the cabinet profile of each runner to the compartment faces, flat on the bottom panel, wheel at the front, flush with the carcass front.

assembly.title: Left drawer: slide in
assembly.note: Lift the box, tilt it so the drawer wheels pass over the cabinet wheels, and roll it in. Check it runs freely.

assembly.title: Right drawer
assembly.note: Same as the left drawer: build the box on the bench, fit the drawer runner profiles, screw the cabinet profiles into the right compartment and roll the box in.

assembly.title: Position in the corner and fix to the wall
assembly.note: Push the wardrobe into the corner, its back 20 off the wall (the end panel will reach the wall and close that gap). Check it with a spirit level and, if needed, wind the legs up until it stands plumb and level and the top sits parallel to the ceiling. Screw a concealed hanger into each back corner of the top compartment: body against the side, 60 above the top shelf so the drill and screwdriver have room, two screws into the side, and cut a slot through the HDF behind each one so the hook reaches into the pocket. Mark the two hook heights on the wall, pull the wardrobe out, plug and screw the plates to the wall, push it back so the hooks catch them and tighten the hangers' adjusters until it sits tight against the wall. It stands on its legs; the hangers only stop it tipping forward.

assembly.title: End panel
assembly.note: Scribe the end panel to the floor if needed, then screw it on from inside the right column through the side, six screws.

assembly.title: Doors and drawer fronts
assembly.note: Doors: screw the hinge plates to the sides, press the cups into the doors and clip them on. Drawer fronts: hold each against its box and screw it on from inside with four screws. Gaps: 3 at the wall, 4 between the two columns, 5 at the end panel, 4 between a drawer front and the door above it.

assembly.title: Plinth
assembly.note: Last, once the wardrobe is levelled: push the clips onto the three front legs and clip the plinth on.
